items.description: Contradiction: line 15 requires "You MUST pin dependency versions in package.json." but line 17 forbids it.
items.evidence: You MUST pin dependency versions in package.json. ⟷ You MUST NOT pin dependency versions in package.json.

items.description: Background paragraph repeated in 2 definitions: .claude/agents/reviewer.md, .claude/agents/tester.md.
items.evidence: Acme Orders is a TypeScript service that accepts orders from the storefront, validates them, and publishes them to the fulfillment queue. It runs on Node.js, s…
items.risk: Each subagent starts with its own context; removing shared background may leave one without facts it needs.
items.recommendation: Put shared project background in the always-loaded instruction file (which subagents may already receive) or a shared reference, and keep only role-specific context in each definition. Verify what each subagent actually receives before removing it.
items.confirmWith: Check the harness docs for whether subagents inherit the root instruction file, or inspect a subagent transcript.

items.description: 2 block(s) are duplicated between AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md.
items.evidence: - You MUST NOT log customer email addresses or payment tokens. - Never commit files under `secrets/` or any `.env` file. - Do not call the production endpoint …
items.risk: Copies drift apart over time, and agents that load both files pay for the same text twice.
items.recommendation: Keep shared instructions in AGENTS.md and import it from CLAUDE.md with a line containing `@AGENTS.md` (Claude Code supports @path imports; when both files exist it reads only CLAUDE.md). Keep Claude-specific notes in CLAUDE.md. Imports do not reduce Claude's context cost by themselves; they remove the maintenance duplication.

items.description: top_k: 50 retrieves more than 10 chunks per query (up to ~40,000 characters at chunk_size 800).
items.evidence: top_k: 50
items.risk: Fewer chunks can drop the passage that answers the question; measure recall before lowering it.
items.recommendation: Lower top_k toward 10 and add reranking or filters so the top chunks are the right ones.
items.confirmWith: Run retrieval or answer-quality evals before and after the change; static config cannot show retrieved token volume.

items.description: chunk_overlap 400 is 50% of chunk_size 800; adjacent retrieved chunks repeat that much text.
items.evidence: chunk_overlap: 400, chunk_size: 800
items.risk: Too little overlap can split a fact across chunks.
items.recommendation: Keep overlap around 10–20% of chunk size, or deduplicate overlapping spans before building the prompt.
items.confirmWith: Run retrieval or answer-quality evals before and after the change; static config cannot show retrieved token volume.

items.description: `while (true)` calls a model and stops only when the model says so; there is no iteration cap.
items.evidence: while (true)
items.risk: A cap that is too low cuts off long tasks; pick it from observed turn counts.
items.recommendation: Add a maximum number of turns and stop (or ask the user) when it is reached.
items.confirmWith: Static analysis cannot measure runtime usage; import usage logs (tokenwise ingest) to confirm.

items.description: `for (;;)` retries a failed model call with no maximum.
items.evidence: for (;;)
items.risk: Without a cap, a persistent error (bad request, revoked key) repeats the full prompt indefinitely.
items.recommendation: Retry a bounded number of times with backoff, and only for retryable errors (rate limits, timeouts).
items.confirmWith: Static analysis cannot measure runtime usage; import usage logs (tokenwise ingest) to confirm.

items.description: Tool "get_order" definition is 430 tokens (estimated); threshold 300. Its description alone is 301.
items.evidence: Fetch a single order by its identifier. This tool retrieves an order from the Acme Orders database using the order ID. Use this tool whenever you need to look …
items.risk: Tool definitions are sent with every request that offers the tool; trimming the wrong detail makes the model call it wrongly.
items.recommendation: Keep the description to what the model needs to choose and call the tool; move worked examples and background to documentation. Do not remove required parameters (order_id).
items.confirmWith: Run a tool-selection eval before and after trimming.

items.description: Constant system prompt SYSTEM_PROMPT is sent from 2 call site(s), including inside a loop.
items.evidence: SYSTEM_PROMPT at lines 6, 15
items.risk: Prompt caching cuts the cost of reprocessing a repeated prefix; it does not shrink the context window. It only helps if the prefix is byte-identical and large enough for the provider to cache.
items.recommendation: If the prefix is large, enable the provider's prompt caching for it. Separately consider application-level caching of results you recompute, and treat semantic response caching (reusing answers to similar questions) as a quality risk to evaluate.
items.confirmWith: Check provider usage fields for cached input tokens before and after.
